reviews.reviewText:
MCQs and Questions from handouts and videos. Some questions were difficult.
Questions:
1. Difference between isomorphism and homomorphism.
2. Define action of group set G of X.
3. Theorem prove: Sylow subgroup P1 and P2 conjugate.
4. Give an example of |G|=2|N|.
5. Homomorphism theorem proof.
6. Question related to Order of G is p^n, (m,n)=1.
7. If G is abelian then homomorphism of H is also abelian on G (Prove).
